title: AAP leaders announce one-day hunger strike against CEC in New Delhi
seoTitle: Delhi AAP hunger strike against CEC

tea.why: Protesting against alleged vote theft and actions of the Election Commission during an ongoing agitation in Delhi.
tea.want: Demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 14: AAP leaders stated their protests would continue non-violently and demanded Ramlila Maidan if Jantar Mantar permission is denied.

summary: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) has announced a one-day hunger strike scheduled for October 15 in New Delhi to protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and alleged vote theft. The decision followed a meeting of party legislators, councillors, and district office-bearers at the AAP headquarters. Leaders including Sanjay Singh, Saurabh Bharadwaj, Gopal Rai, and Imran Hussain participated in discussions to intensify the ongoing agitation. According to sources, party members previously attempted a march towards Jantar Mantar, where police intervened, leading to clashes and the temporary detention of several leaders and workers. AAP representatives stated they would continue their demonstrations despite police action and criticized the de-notification of Jantar Mantar as a protest venue, requesting alternative space at Ramlila Maidan if necessary.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Permission to hold protests at alternative sites like Ramlila Maidan
response: According to the sources, Delhi Police stopped AAP workers near Janpath during a march and temporarily detained several leaders and participants, including Sanjay Singh and Saurabh Bharadwaj, before releasing them later in the evening.

updates.text: AAP announced a one-day hunger strike for October 15 at a meeting led by party figures, following clashes and detentions near Janpath.
AAP leader Saurabh Bharadwaj stated the party would not back down and demanded either Jantar Mantar or Ramlila Maidan for their protest.
